items.quote: Need or Like? It's the same with clients – if they would just like to sell... They will never negotiate the price.
items.statement: Clients who only 'like' to sell will never negotiate the price.

items.quote: Find the ones who need to sell or buy.
items.statement: Find clients who need to sell or buy.

overview: This source chunk discusses client engagement strategies in sales, emphasizing the difference between clients who want to sell versus those who need to sell.
